items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: well him and Christian McBride and Carl Allen and you know, just being in the band with Freddie Hubbard

ctx.x: If so, speak up. XX: Did you see Benny Green’s Facebook essay on working with Freddie Hubbard? Freddie Hubbard telling him lay out. Did you see that?

I did. I did. Well I’ve spoken to Benny about those times you know and well him and Christian McBride and Carl Allen and you know, just being in the band with Freddie Hubbard and what Freddie expected. And funny enough, a lot of what they do, some of that stems from being in Freddie’s band. The way they present the music. The way they play the music. You know if you’ve ever noticed, they never — well I won’t say never — but pretty much most of the time usually when they play a tune it’s always like right on it.…
Well it’s been a pleasure talking to you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
